candidates.name: Taba–Sharm El-Sheikh Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: OGJ trade report on the EGAS/Gasco national-grid expansion: 220 km, 20 in., up to 6 MMcfd, went on line early 2007 at ~LE 511M; serves cities on the route, hotels/tourist villages and power stations at Taba, Nuweiba, Dahab and Sharm El-Sheikh (South Sinai east coast).

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row runs down the South Sinai east coast. The roster's Sinai/Arab Gas lines are P0436 Arish–Taba, P7482 Taba–Aqaba, P0462 Arish–Ashkelon — all along the north coast / into Jordan. A 220 km trunk from Taba south to Sharm El-Sheikh feeding coastal cities and power stations is a distinct transmission line not present under any listed PID (nearest by name is P0436/P7482 but those terminate at/near Taba going the opposite direction). Single verified source (OGJ), tracing to Gasco; corroboration is OGJ/GEM-linked only, so treat as medium/low pending a second independent source.

candidates.name: Shukeir–Hurghada Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: OGJ report on Gasco grid expansion lists Shukeir–Hurgada line: 127 km, 24 in., ~7 MMcfd, completed 2006; extends the national grid down the Red Sea west coast to Hurghada.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Roster has P6034 Hurghada–Safaga (38.5 km, 24 in.) only — the downstream continuation. The 127 km Ras Shukeir–Hurghada trunk that brings gas from the Gulf of Suez down to Hurghada is upstream of P6034 and is not represented under any roster PID. Could be viewed as the parent of P6034, but is a separate physical transmission segment. Single verified source (OGJ), tracing to Gasco — medium/low pending independent corroboration.
